baseline_models.focus_anchor: جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًا joins state-making, a beneficiary, the lower ground, and a spread expanse.
baseline_models.mechanism: Divine state-making configures the lower ground as a broad underfoot expanse. The carpet image concerns usable disposition relative to its users, not a freestanding geometric claim.

activation_trace.role: Turning something into a state supplies active configuration, making spreadness an appointed condition.
The lower ground opposite the sky supplies the underfoot member of the spatial relation.
The spread-out expanse of ground supplies the furnished, broad surface that completes the configuration.

changed_reading.after: Allah configured the lower ground as a broad, usable spread for its recipients.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The predicate بِسَاطًا and the beneficiary phrase لَكُمُ allow the spread to be read as granted capacity and reach.
baseline_models.mechanism: Breadth is not only surface shape: spacious capacity and roaming range make the earth an affordance of room, reach, and access bestowed on the addressees.

activation_trace.role: State-making supplies the transition by which spatial capacity becomes a beneficiary-facing condition.
Spacious increase and ample capacity supply room as the practical content of the spread.
Roaming broadly through land supplies reach and movement as consequences of that capacity.

changed_reading.before: The earth resembles a flat carpet.
changed_reading.after: The earth is a grant of spatial capacity, reach, and accessible range.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus itself pairs ٱلْأَرْضَ with بِسَاطًا, while the earth inventory independently contains a thick-mat image.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two focus roots mutually reinforce a material furnishing analogy: the earth is not merely an abstract plane but a substantial underlay laid out beneath its users.

activation_trace.role: The thick-mat image supplies substance and load-bearing depth to the noun earth.
The carpet or ground spread out supplies the laid-under relation that turns substance into furnishing.

changed_reading.before: Carpet is only a visual simile for flatness.
changed_reading.after: The paired roots evoke a substantial laid-out underlayer that supports embodied life.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated جعل places gardens, rivers, moonlight, the solar lamp, and finally earth into roles. This strengthens a functional reading of 71:19: earth is appointed as a spread rather than merely brought into existence.

activation_trace.role: State-making supplies the focus operation whose force is tested by repetition.
Turning things into beneficiary-facing states supplies the parallel appointments of gardens and rivers.
Turning things into states supplies the operational appointments of the moon as light and the sun as lamp.
The spread-out ground image supplies the particular role assigned to earth.

structural_cues: The packet repeats جعل for gardens and rivers in 71:12, for both luminaries in 71:16, and for earth in 71:19.
The repetitions move from produced benefits and cosmic instruments to the addressees' ground.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated state-making around gardens, lights, and earth; I infer a shared function-assignment pattern; alternatively, each جعل may simply denote making without one operational template.

changed_reading.after: جعل appoints earth to the practical role of a spread, alongside other contextually assigned functions.

context_deltas.mechanism: The rain-to-supply-to-garden-and-river sequence activates بسط as ample capacity. The earth's breadth becomes a receptive and channelled provisioning surface, not empty acreage.

activation_trace.role: Spacious increase and capacity supply the focus surface's ability to hold and distribute benefit.
Abundant outflow from a source supplies the incoming replenishment that the earth receives.
Connected increase that supplies another thing provides continuity between inflow and sustained provision.
The tree-covered garden supplies one productive form taken by the replenished surface.
A flowing river cleaving the earth supplies channels through which the surface's capacity becomes organized.

structural_cues: 71:11-12 runs from pouring sky through continued supply to gardens and rivers.
71:12 and 71:19 both use beneficiary language and جعل.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies abundant inflow, continued supplementation, gardens, and earth-cutting rivers; I infer an ecological chain realized on the spread earth; alternatively, these may be parallel benefits rather than one material system.

changed_reading.after: The spread offers replenishable capacity that receives, grows, and channels provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The superposed-heavens image places the focus spread in a vertical arrangement. Earth reads as the user-facing lower plane beneath layered upper structures, not as a claim that all reality is an unlayered flat surface.

activation_trace.role: The lower ground opposite the sky supplies the bottom member of the vertical relation.
The spread-out ground supplies the inhabitable lower plane within that relation.
Layers placed one above another supply the upper architecture against which the lower spread is oriented.

structural_cues: 71:15 establishes superposed heavens, 71:16 places lights within them, and 71:19 names earth as spread.
The focus earth branch explicitly distinguishes lower ground from sky.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies upper layers and a lower-ground focus image; I infer a contrastive vertical architecture; alternatively, the signs may remain parallel images without composing one spatial model.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes the universe as a flat surface.
changed_reading.after: The verse presents earth as the accessible lower plane within a layered created order.

context_deltas.mechanism: Growth from earth, return into it, and forceful emergence from it turn the spread into a two-way life-cycle medium. It supports bodies, receives them, and serves as the boundary of renewed appearance.

activation_trace.role: The spread ground supplies the continuous medium across which the cycle is staged.
Plant growth emerging from earth supplies the outward generative phase applied to human origin.
Soft fertile ground supplies the receptive substrate from which growth can issue.
Return after departure supplies the inward reversal from emergence back into earth.
Passing to the outside supplies renewed emergence across the earth boundary.

structural_cues: 71:17 grows the addressees from earth, 71:18 returns them into it and brings them out, and 71:19 restates earth.
The pronoun فيها in 71:18 carries earth through both directional movements.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies growth from earth, return into it, and extraction from it; I infer that the focus spread functions as their shared process medium; alternatively, the sequence may be rhetorical without specifying a material mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Earth is an inert floor on which life stands.
changed_reading.after: Earth is a generative, receiving, and releasing medium across the human life cycle.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate purpose clause resolves spreadness into mobility: people penetrate extended routes through broad openings. The carpet is therefore route-bearing infrastructure rather than merely scenery.

activation_trace.role: Roaming lengthwise and crosswise through land supplies mobility as a latent focus affordance.
Penetrating along a road supplies the enacted movement enabled by the spread.
An extended route that is travelled supplies the network form taken by open range.
A broad opening between mountains supplies passages through obstacles rather than featureless flatness.

structural_cues: 71:20 immediately follows with a purpose lām and the backward-pointing منها.
The route nouns pluralize the one spread into multiple traversable ways.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies purpose syntax, penetration, extended routes, and broad passes; I infer that spreading enables traversal; alternatively, منها may locate the routes in earth without asserting a designed transport system.

changed_reading.before: The carpet image denotes open space.
changed_reading.after: The carpet image denotes an earth configured to carry a network of traversable passages.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth grants traversable ways, but the later deviation from right aim shows that mobility does not guarantee orientation. Spatial affordance becomes an ethically open field in which routes can be used while direction is lost.

activation_trace.role: Broad roaming supplies the morally neutral capacity to move across the focus earth.
The extended travelled road supplies literal available paths.
Deviation from guidance and intended aim supplies the loss of orientation that open paths do not prevent.

structural_cues: Literal ways in 71:20 are followed by a social-idolatrous sequence culminating in misguidance in 71:24.
The focus says the spread is for the addressees but does not itself prescribe their direction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies literal roads and later deviation from right aim; I infer a spatial-ethical analogy in which affordance leaves direction open; alternatively, the road and guidance domains may be independent.

changed_reading.before: A spread made for people is automatically beneficial mobility.
changed_reading.after: The spread grants agency-bearing mobility, but neither selects nor secures the traveller's orientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The spread can be filled by water and then imagined without a resident. Thus لَكُمُ marks provisioned habitability, not guaranteed refuge or permanent tenure; the same ground can cease to function as a human spread.

activation_trace.role: The spread-out ground supplies the initially habitable surface whose function is later reversed.
Earth filled with water supplies the physical reversal of dry underfoot usability.
The lower ground supplies the same spatial domain on which continued residence is questioned.
The resident affiliated with a dwelling supplies habitation as the function that can be removed.

structural_cues: 71:25 names inundation and 71:26 immediately asks that no resident remain upon earth.
The later earth occurrence repeats the focus domain under a reversal of habitation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inundation, repeated earth, and the resident image; I infer that habitability is a contingent function of the bestowed spread; alternatively, judgment may remove people without revising what 71:19 says about earth itself.

changed_reading.before: The earth is a permanently available human carpet.
changed_reading.after: The earth is provisioned as habitat, but its dry usability and occupancy can be withdrawn.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The saddle-frame branch is specialized and form-distant, but it remains anchored in the focus بسط inventory and gains mechanism from the immediate traversal verse. Render it only as a load-bearing material analogy, not as the lexical meaning of بِسَاطًا or a claim about earth's shape.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The بِسَاطًا root inventory includes an undivided spread saddle-frame, while 71:20 activates travel through broad passes.

activation_trace.role: The undivided spread saddle-frame supplies a specialized image of support that bears movement.
Penetration along a road supplies the movement borne by that support analogy.
Broad mountain passes supply the uneven openings across which support, rather than sheer flatness, matters.

changed_reading.before: Earth is a carpet looked at from above.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, earth is a load-bearing spread that carries embodied passage through terrain.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The social-ease branch of بسط crosses from terrain into interpersonal conduct, so this is surprising and should not be translated into the verse. It remains anchored in بِسَاطًا and in the packet's public, declared, and secret address sequence; render it only as a secondary affordance of an opened human field.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: بِسَاطًا carries a branch of open social ease, and لَكُمُ makes the configured earth relational to a human plurality.

activation_trace.role: Open ease of tongue, face, and association supplies a social extension of physical openness.
Calling and inclining others by speech supplies the interpersonal action carried across the shared field.
Public announcement and raised voice supply the field's overt communicative mode.
Making something manifest supplies deliberate public exposure within the social field.
Hiding something inwardly supplies the complementary private mode that the same human field permits.

changed_reading.before: The spread is exclusively physical terrain.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the opened terrain also functions as a shared social field for public and private address.

strongest_changes: The 71:20 purpose clause converts the carpet image into traversable route infrastructure.
The 71:17-18 sequence turns earth from inert floor into a growth, return, and emergence medium.
Repeated جعل and the 71:11-12 provision sequence recast spreadness as functional appointment and replenishable capacity.
The inundation and no-resident sequence makes habitability a reversible function rather than permanent tenure.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots already support furnished expanse, ample reach, and substantial underlay; context activates these as ecological, life-cycle, route-bearing, ethical, and reversible functions without forcing them into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: Repeated جعل may mark shared functional assignment or only repeated making.
The life-cycle medium and provisioning chain may be mechanisms or tightly sequenced rhetorical analogies.
The ethical path analogy is live but not required by the literal road vocabulary.
The saddle-frame and social-field readings are branch-backed analogies, not proposed lexical senses.
